name: events
description: Hook into DuckDB's internal events — query begin/end, transactions, connections — and ship them as JSON to any external program via stdin. Audit logging, error alerting, observability integration, and SIEM feeds, all configured with PRAGMAs.

cta.title: Stream DuckDB Events Out
cta.description: Install Events to forward query, transaction, and connection events as JSON lines to any handler program — log shipping, audit trails, observability.
